# Format support matrix

<!-- Generated by `romux formats --markdown` from live backend declarations. Do not edit by hand. -->

Values: `supported` (works for every valid instance), `conditional` (works when a detectable condition holds — keys, plaintext content, codecs), `read-only`, `unsupported`.

## Notes per format

### `3ds.cci` — CCI (.3ds)

NCSD cartridge image. Extensions: `.3ds`, `.cci`.

- **probe**: supported — NCSD magic at 0x100
- **inspect**: supported — media ID, partitions, NCCH headers
- **list**: conditional — partition NCCHs always; ExeFS/RomFS files for NoCrypto or key-decrypted partitions
- **extract**: conditional — NCCH partitions always; files for NoCrypto or key-decrypted partitions
- **verify**: conditional — structure; ExeFS/RomFS superblock and file hashes for NoCrypto or key-decrypted partitions
- **convert**: conditional — to an unsigned CIA (NoCrypto, or decrypted with user keys); not installable on retail systems

### `3ds.cia` — CIA

installable title archive. Extensions: `.cia`.

- **probe**: supported — 0x2020 header size
- **inspect**: supported — title ID, version, content chunks
- **list**: supported — certs, ticket, TMD, contents, meta
- **extract**: supported — sections and contents as stored
- **verify**: conditional — TMD SHA-256 of contents (encrypted contents need ctr_common_key_N)
- **repack**: unsupported — signed CIAs cannot be produced
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — 3DS updates are separate installable titles

### `3ds.ncch` — NCCH (CXI/CFA)

content container. Extensions: `.cxi`, `.cfa`, `.app`.

- **probe**: supported — NCCH magic at 0x100
- **inspect**: supported — program ID, product code, flags
- **list**: conditional — NoCrypto, or encrypted with slot0x2CKeyX etc. and generator
- **extract**: conditional — NoCrypto, or encrypted with user keys
- **verify**: conditional — hashes of plaintext content (encrypted content needs keys)

### `archive.zar` — ZArchive

zstd-block archive of an extracted game tree (Cemu, Xenia). Extensions: `.zar`.

- **probe**: supported — footer magic 0x169F52D6 and version
- **inspect**: supported — block count, sizes, detected content platform
- **list**: supported — file tree
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths (requires zstd)
- **verify**: supported — section bounds, tree structure, footer SHA-256 integrity hash
- **repack**: supported — deterministic archive from a directory

### `disc.bin` — Raw CD image

single-track raw 2352-byte sector image. Extensions: `.bin`, `.img`.

- **probe**: supported — CD sync pattern and mode byte
- **inspect**: supported — sector mode
- **list**: supported — track and filesystem
- **extract**: supported — filesystem files
- **verify**: supported — Mode 1 EDC per sector
- **convert**: conditional — to ISO9660 for Mode 1 / Mode 2 Form 1 data; sync/headers/ECC not preserved

### `disc.chd` — CHD

Compressed Hunks of Data v3/v4/v5. Extensions: `.chd`.

- **probe**: supported — MComprHD signature
- **inspect**: supported — header, codecs, metadata, CD tracks, parent reference
- **list**: supported — tracks or image, plus ISO9660 filesystem when present
- **extract**: conditional — requires decodable codecs (decodes zlib, huff, cdzl, flac, cdfl, zstd, cdzs, lzma, cdlz; A/V codecs unsupported) and the parent CHD when referenced
- **verify**: conditional — map CRC, per-hunk CRC, raw and overall SHA-1 (needs decodable codecs)
- **decompress**: conditional — to ISO9660 (DVD/raw) or CUE/BIN (CD); byte-identical logical data Requires: Codec("per-hunk codecs").
- **compress**: supported — v5 writer; zlib/zstd (DVD) and cdzl/cdzs (CD)

### `disc.cue` — CUE/BIN

CUE sheet referencing BIN track files. Extensions: `.cue`.

- **probe**: supported — text sheet with FILE/TRACK/INDEX
- **inspect**: supported — tracks, modes, indexes, pregaps
- **list**: supported — tracks and the ISO9660 filesystem of the first data track
- **extract**: supported — raw tracks and data-track files
- **verify**: supported — layout checks and Mode 1 EDC
- **compress**: supported — to CHD (CD layout, cdzl/cdzs codecs, subcode not preserved)
- **convert**: conditional — first data track to ISO9660 when it carries 2048-byte user data

### `disc.iso9660` — ISO9660 image

ECMA-119 filesystem on 2048-byte sectors (Joliet names preferred). Extensions: `.iso`.

- **probe**: supported — primary volume descriptor at sector 16
- **inspect**: supported — volume descriptors
- **list**: supported — directory hierarchy; Rock Ridge extensions ignored
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths
- **verify**: supported — structure only; ISO9660 declares no content hashes or signatures
- **repack**: supported — deterministic image from a directory tree (relaxed names, no Joliet)
- **compress**: supported — to CHD (DVD layout)
- **bundle**: unsupported — no multi-title semantics
- **apply-update**: unsupported — no update semantics
- **split**: unsupported — no multi-content semantics

### `gamecube.iso` — GameCube disc

GameCube disc image (GCM). Extensions: `.iso`, `.gcm`.

- **probe**: supported — GameCube magic 0xC2339F3D at 0x1C
- **inspect**: supported — disc header (game ID, maker, title, region)
- **list**: supported — sys/ files and FST tree
- **extract**: supported — sys/boot.bin, bi2.bin, apploader.img, main.dol, fst.bin and files/
- **verify**: supported — header, FST bounds; GameCube discs carry no content hashes
- **compress**: supported — to RVZ (zstd groups, junk packed), byte-identical
- **convert**: supported — to RVZ

### `n64.n64` — N64 ROM (little-endian)

32-bit little-endian word cartridge image. Extensions: `.n64`.

- **probe**: supported — PI header word in one of the three byte orders
- **inspect**: supported — title, game code, region, revision, CIC, checksums, size
- **list**: supported — normalised big-endian ROM, header and IPL3 boot code views
- **extract**: supported — the views above
- **verify**: supported — CIC identified from IPL3; header CRC1/CRC2 recomputed
- **convert**: supported — to the other byte orders (lossless)
- **repack**: unsupported — cartridges have no filesystem
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — N64 titles have no update packages

### `n64.v64` — N64 ROM (byte-swapped)

16-bit byte-swapped cartridge image (Doctor V64). Extensions: `.v64`.

- **probe**: supported — PI header word in one of the three byte orders
- **inspect**: supported — title, game code, region, revision, CIC, checksums, size
- **list**: supported — normalised big-endian ROM, header and IPL3 boot code views
- **extract**: supported — the views above
- **verify**: supported — CIC identified from IPL3; header CRC1/CRC2 recomputed
- **convert**: supported — to the other byte orders (lossless)
- **repack**: unsupported — cartridges have no filesystem
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — N64 titles have no update packages

### `n64.z64` — N64 ROM (big-endian)

native big-endian cartridge image. Extensions: `.z64`.

- **probe**: supported — PI header word in one of the three byte orders
- **inspect**: supported — title, game code, region, revision, CIC, checksums, size
- **list**: supported — normalised big-endian ROM, header and IPL3 boot code views
- **extract**: supported — the views above
- **verify**: supported — CIC identified from IPL3; header CRC1/CRC2 recomputed
- **convert**: supported — to the other byte orders (lossless)
- **repack**: unsupported — cartridges have no filesystem
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — N64 titles have no update packages

### `ps4.pkg` — PS4 PKG

PS4 package container (\x7FCNT). Extensions: `.pkg`.

- **probe**: supported — \x7FCNT magic with PS4 content ID layout
- **inspect**: supported — header, content ID, DRM/content type, entries; param.sfo when stored unencrypted
- **list**: supported — package-table entries and PFS image region
- **extract**: conditional — unencrypted package-table entries only; encrypted entries and PFS contents are not decrypted
- **verify**: supported — structure (bounds, overlaps, entry table); digests/signatures not checked
- **repack**: unsupported — Romux cannot produce validly signed or encrypted PS4 packages
- **convert**: unsupported — no declared conversions
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — patch PKGs replace files inside encrypted PFS images
- **scan**: supported — grouped by title ID

### `ps4.sfo` — PS4 param.sfo

PSF key/value table with PS4 keys. Extensions: `.sfo`.

- **probe**: supported — PSF magic with PS4-specific keys
- **inspect**: supported — all keys
- **list**: supported — keys
- **verify**: supported — table structure

### `psp.cso` — CSO

CISO v1 block-compressed image. Extensions: `.cso`.

- **probe**: supported — CISO magic, version 1, index table bounds
- **inspect**: supported — block size, compression ratio, inner image
- **list**: supported — decompressed image and its filesystem
- **extract**: supported — filesystem files
- **verify**: supported — index monotonicity, every block decodes to its size
- **decompress**: supported — to ISO, byte-identical

### `psp.iso` — PSP UMD ISO

ISO9660 image with PSP_GAME / UMD_DATA.BIN. Extensions: `.iso`.

- **probe**: supported — ISO9660 plus PSP_GAME/PARAM.SFO or UMD_DATA.BIN
- **inspect**: supported — PARAM.SFO and UMD_DATA.BIN metadata
- **list**: supported — filesystem
- **extract**: supported — filesystem files (EBOOT.BIN stays encrypted when encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — ISO9660 structure
- **compress**: supported — to CSO v1 (deflate), byte-identical
- **convert**: supported — to CSO
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — PSP updates are encrypted EBOOT replacements

### `psp.pbp` — PBP

EBOOT.PBP section container. Extensions: `.pbp`.

- **probe**: supported — \0PBP magic with ordered section offsets
- **inspect**: supported — PARAM.SFO and section sizes
- **list**: supported — eight sections
- **extract**: supported — sections as stored (DATA.PSP may be encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — section table ordering and bounds
- **repack**: supported — build a PBP from section files (library API: romux::psp::write_pbp)

### `psp.sfo` — PSP PARAM.SFO

PSF table with PSP keys. Extensions: `.sfo`.

- **probe**: supported — PSF with PSP keys
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **verify**: supported

### `snes.sfc` — SNES ROM

headerless cartridge image. Extensions: `.sfc`, `.smc`.

- **probe**: supported — scored internal header (LoROM, HiROM, ExHiROM); copier header from the size
- **inspect**: supported — title, game code, region, version, mapping, speed, chipset, ROM/SRAM sizes, checksum
- **list**: supported — headerless ROM, internal header and copier header views
- **extract**: supported — the views above
- **verify**: supported — checksum/complement pair and recomputed checksum (mirrored for odd sizes)
- **convert**: supported — to SMC (adds a 512-byte copier header)
- **repack**: unsupported — cartridges have no filesystem
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — SNES titles have no update packages

### `snes.smc` — SNES ROM with copier header

512-byte copier header + cartridge image. Extensions: `.smc`, `.swc`, `.fig`.

- **probe**: supported — scored internal header (LoROM, HiROM, ExHiROM); copier header from the size
- **inspect**: supported — title, game code, region, version, mapping, speed, chipset, ROM/SRAM sizes, checksum
- **list**: supported — headerless ROM, internal header and copier header views
- **extract**: supported — the views above
- **verify**: supported — checksum/complement pair and recomputed checksum (mirrored for odd sizes)
- **convert**: supported — to SFC (drops the copier header)
- **repack**: unsupported — cartridges have no filesystem
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — SNES titles have no update packages

### `switch.hfs0` — HFS0

hashed partition filesystem. Extensions: `.hfs0`.

- **probe**: supported — HFS0 magic
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **extract**: supported
- **verify**: supported — per-entry SHA-256 of hashed regions
- **repack**: supported — library API: hfs0::write

### `switch.nca` — NCA

encrypted content archive. Extensions: `.nca`.

- **probe**: conditional — plaintext headers by magic; encrypted headers only weakly (extension + size) — never decrypted while probing
- **inspect**: conditional — header fields need header_key Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **list**: conditional — sections and their PFS0/RomFS files need section keys Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **extract**: conditional — decrypted section files Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **verify**: conditional — fs-header and master hashes; content ID Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **compress**: conditional — to NCZ Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **bundle**: unsupported — bundle packages, not single archives
- **apply-update**: unsupported — supply base and update packages

### `switch.ncz` — NCZ

compressed NCA (NCZSECTN). Extensions: `.ncz`.

- **probe**: supported — NCZSECTN at 0x4000
- **inspect**: supported — section table, block info; NCA header needs header_key
- **list**: supported — restored NCA and its sections when keys are available
- **extract**: supported — restored NCA
- **verify**: supported — restored content-ID SHA-256
- **decompress**: conditional — byte-identical NCA restoration without keys Requires: Codec("zstd").

### `switch.nsp` — NSP

PFS0 package of NCAs, tickets and certificates. Extensions: `.nsp`.

- **probe**: supported — PFS0 magic; NCZ members distinguish NSZ
- **inspect**: supported — container always; titles/versions from CNMT (keys), .cnmt.xml, or ticket IDs
- **list**: supported — members (and partitions for gamecard images)
- **extract**: supported — members as stored (NCAs stay encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — structure, HFS0 hashes, content-ID SHA-256, CNMT hashes when readable; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: conditional — base + update + DLC kept as separate content sets; role validation needs CNMT/.cnmt.xml Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **split**: conditional — one package per content set; needs CNMT metadata Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **apply-update**: conditional — BKTR reconstruction to a decrypted tree Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **repack**: unsupported — use bundle/convert; manifest-driven repacking of retail content is not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by application ID
- **convert**: conditional — to XCI/XCZ: rights-ID titles need --convert-rights (headers modified, keys required) Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **compress**: conditional — NCAs decrypted and zstd-compressed into NCZ (solid or block) Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), Codec("zstd").
- **decompress**: unsupported — not compressed

### `switch.nsz` — NSZ

NSP whose NCAs are stored as NCZ. Extensions: `.nsz`.

- **probe**: supported — PFS0 magic; NCZ members distinguish NSZ
- **inspect**: supported — container always; titles/versions from CNMT (keys), .cnmt.xml, or ticket IDs
- **list**: supported — members (and partitions for gamecard images)
- **extract**: supported — members as stored (NCAs stay encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — structure, HFS0 hashes, content-ID SHA-256, CNMT hashes when readable; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: conditional — base + update + DLC kept as separate content sets; role validation needs CNMT/.cnmt.xml Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **split**: conditional — one package per content set; needs CNMT metadata Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **apply-update**: conditional — BKTR reconstruction to a decrypted tree Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **repack**: unsupported — use bundle/convert; manifest-driven repacking of retail content is not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by application ID
- **convert**: conditional — to XCI/XCZ: rights-ID titles need --convert-rights (headers modified, keys required) Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **decompress**: conditional — restores every NCA byte-identically (content IDs re-verified); no keys needed Requires: Codec("zstd").
- **compress**: unsupported — already compressed

### `switch.nup` — NUP

container of unencrypted Switch 1/2 ExeFS/RomFS trees (base, updates, add-ons). Extensions: `.nup`.

- **probe**: supported — NUP magic (major version 1)
- **inspect**: supported — packages, title IDs, versions and metadata TLVs; no keys needed
- **list**: supported — package trees
- **extract**: supported — files (zstd extents decoded)
- **verify**: supported — superblock, TOC SHA-256, tree structure, UUID; content: per-file SHA-256
- **convert**: conditional — built from NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ by decrypting and extracting ExeFS/RomFS (keys); BKTR updates applied to their base Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **bundle**: conditional — switch bundle --format nup: one game's base + updates + add-ons Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **repack**: unsupported — packing loose dump folders is not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by title ID

### `switch.nx` — NX

archive of decrypted Switch 1/2 games: base, updates and DLC as complete snapshots over deduplicated blocks. Extensions: `.nx`.

- **probe**: supported — NXAR magic and header CRC-32C (slot A or B)
- **inspect**: supported — applications, programs, snapshots, display metadata; no keys needed
- **list**: supported — snapshot trees (DNCA units), metadata media, source resources
- **extract**: supported — snapshot files, every read CRC-32C checked
- **verify**: supported — header CRC, section SHA-256, layout, snapshot identities; content: every block slice and file SHA-256
- **convert**: conditional — built from NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ by decrypting every NCA (keys); updates need their base among the inputs Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **bundle**: conditional — switch bundle --format nx: base + updates + DLC in one archive Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **repack**: unsupported — rebuild recipes and in-place edits are not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by application ID

### `switch.pfs0` — PFS0

bare partition filesystem (e.g. ExeFS). Extensions: `.pfs0`, `.exefs`.

- **probe**: supported — PFS0 magic without NCA members
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **extract**: supported
- **verify**: supported — structure (no per-file hashes)
- **repack**: supported — library API: pfs0::layout + package::write_nsp

### `switch.romfs` — RomFS

level-3 RomFS image (as extracted from an NCA). Extensions: `.romfs`.

- **probe**: supported — header layout heuristics (low confidence)
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **extract**: supported
- **verify**: supported — table structure
- **repack**: supported — library API: romux::switch::RomfsBuilder

### `switch.xci` — XCI

gamecard-style image with HFS0 partitions. Extensions: `.xci`.

- **probe**: supported — HEAD magic and root HFS0
- **inspect**: supported — container always; titles/versions from CNMT (keys), .cnmt.xml, or ticket IDs
- **list**: supported — members (and partitions for gamecard images)
- **extract**: supported — members as stored (NCAs stay encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — structure, HFS0 hashes, content-ID SHA-256, CNMT hashes when readable; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: conditional — base + update + DLC kept as separate content sets; role validation needs CNMT/.cnmt.xml Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **split**: conditional — one package per content set; needs CNMT metadata Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **apply-update**: conditional — BKTR reconstruction to a decrypted tree Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **repack**: unsupported — use bundle/convert; manifest-driven repacking of retail content is not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by application ID
- **convert**: conditional — to NSP/NSZ: container change; NCAs keep gamecard distribution type
- **compress**: conditional — NCAs decrypted and zstd-compressed into NCZ (solid or block) Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), Codec("zstd").
- **decompress**: unsupported — not compressed

### `switch.xcz` — XCZ

XCI whose NCAs are stored as NCZ. Extensions: `.xcz`.

- **probe**: supported — HEAD magic and root HFS0
- **inspect**: supported — container always; titles/versions from CNMT (keys), .cnmt.xml, or ticket IDs
- **list**: supported — members (and partitions for gamecard images)
- **extract**: supported — members as stored (NCAs stay encrypted)
- **verify**: supported — structure, HFS0 hashes, content-ID SHA-256, CNMT hashes when readable; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: conditional — base + update + DLC kept as separate content sets; role validation needs CNMT/.cnmt.xml Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key").
- **split**: conditional — one package per content set; needs CNMT metadata Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX").
- **apply-update**: conditional — BKTR reconstruction to a decrypted tree Requires: KeyMaterial("header_key"), KeyMaterial("key_area_key_application_XX"), KeyMaterial("titlekek_XX").
- **repack**: unsupported — use bundle/convert; manifest-driven repacking of retail content is not offered
- **scan**: supported — grouped by application ID
- **convert**: conditional — to NSP/NSZ: container change; NCAs keep gamecard distribution type
- **decompress**: conditional — restores every NCA byte-identically (content IDs re-verified); no keys needed Requires: Codec("zstd").
- **compress**: unsupported — already compressed

### `vita.pkg` — PKG (PS3/PSP/Vita family)

\x7FPKG package; contents encrypted. Extensions: `.pkg`.

- **probe**: supported — \x7FPKG magic
- **inspect**: conditional — header and unencrypted metadata entries only
- **list**: read-only — metadata entries; item table is encrypted
- **extract**: unsupported — package items are encrypted; decryption is not provided
- **verify**: supported — header bounds only
- **repack**: unsupported

### `vita.sfo` — Vita param.sfo

PSF with PSP2 keys. Extensions: `.sfo`.

- **probe**: supported
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **verify**: supported

### `vita.vpk` — VPK

ZIP-based homebrew package with sce_sys/param.sfo. Extensions: `.vpk`.

- **probe**: supported — ZIP structure containing sce_sys/param.sfo
- **inspect**: supported — param.sfo
- **list**: supported — ZIP entries
- **extract**: supported — stored and deflate entries
- **verify**: supported — central directory structure and per-entry CRC-32
- **repack**: supported — rebuild from a directory (requires sce_sys/param.sfo)
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported

### `wii.iso` — Wii disc

Wii disc image with encrypted partitions. Extensions: `.iso`, `.wii`.

- **probe**: supported — Wii magic 0x5D1C9EA3 at 0x18 and partition table
- **inspect**: supported — disc header, partitions, title IDs, region
- **list**: conditional — partition tickets/TMDs always; partition files need the common key
- **extract**: conditional — decrypted partition sys/ and files/ Requires: KeyMaterial("wii_common_key").
- **verify**: conditional — H3 table vs TMD always; H0–H3 cluster hashes with the common key Requires: KeyMaterial("wii_common_key").
- **compress**: supported — to WBFS (all-zero blocks omitted); to RVZ with the common key (wii_common_key)
- **convert**: supported — to WBFS; to RVZ with the common key
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — Wii discs carry system updates, not title patches

### `wii.rvz` — RVZ

Dolphin RVZ compressed disc (GameCube or Wii). Extensions: `.rvz`.

- **probe**: supported — RVZ magic, header hashes
- **inspect**: supported — headers, compression, disc header
- **list**: supported — GameCube files; Wii partition files read from the stored decrypted data (no key needed)
- **extract**: supported — as list
- **verify**: supported — header SHA-1s; GameCube: every group decodes; Wii: regenerated hash trees checked against each H3 table
- **decompress**: supported — GameCube images restore byte-identically (incl. LFG junk); Wii partitions are re-encrypted with the stored title key and hash trees regenerated

### `wii.u8` — U8

U8 archive. Extensions: `.arc`, `.u8`, `.app`.

- **probe**: supported — 0x55AA382D magic
- **inspect**: supported
- **list**: supported
- **extract**: supported
- **verify**: supported — node table and bounds
- **repack**: supported — deterministic archive from a directory

### `wii.wad` — WAD

installable title archive. Extensions: `.wad`.

- **probe**: supported — header size 0x20 and type Is/ib/Bk
- **inspect**: supported — title ID, version, contents
- **list**: supported — cert, ticket, TMD, contents, footer
- **extract**: supported — sections as stored; decrypted contents with the common key
- **verify**: conditional — content SHA-1 needs the common key Requires: KeyMaterial("wii_common_key").

### `wii.wbfs` — WBFS

sparse Wii disc container. Extensions: `.wbfs`.

- **probe**: supported — WBFS magic and sector sizes
- **inspect**: supported — disc header copy, used blocks
- **list**: supported — reconstructed disc (and its contents, see wii.iso)
- **extract**: supported — reconstructed disc image
- **verify**: supported — block table bounds
- **decompress**: supported — to ISO; omitted blocks become zeros (original filler may not be recoverable)
- **compress**: conditional — to RVZ with the common key (wii_common_key)

### `wii.wia` — WIA

WIA compressed disc. Extensions: `.wia`.

- **probe**: supported — WIA magic
- **inspect**: supported — headers
- **decompress**: conditional — none/LZMA/LZMA2 compression; bzip2 and purge unsupported

### `wiiu.title` — Installable title

title.tmd with .app/.h3 contents. Extensions: `.tmd`.

- **probe**: supported — Wii U TMD layout (content records at 0xB04)
- **inspect**: supported — title ID, version, content list
- **list**: supported — TMD, ticket, contents present in the folder
- **extract**: supported — contents as stored (encrypted)
- **verify**: conditional — content presence and sizes; hashes of encrypted contents need decryption (not provided)
- **apply-update**: conditional — decrypted code/content/meta trees only: update files replace base files
- **convert**: unsupported — installable titles and disc images are not interchangeable

### `wiiu.wud` — WUD

raw Wii U disc image. Extensions: `.wud`.

- **probe**: supported — WUP- product code at offset 0 and disc-sized image
- **inspect**: supported — product code; partitions are encrypted
- **list**: read-only — whole image only
- **extract**: unsupported — disc partitions are encrypted; decryption is not provided
- **verify**: supported — size and header checks
- **compress**: supported — to WUX (identical-sector deduplication), byte-identical

### `wiiu.wux` — WUX

sector-deduplicated WUD. Extensions: `.wux`.

- **probe**: supported — WUX0 magic pair
- **inspect**: supported — sector size, unique sectors, product code
- **list**: supported — restored image
- **extract**: supported — restored WUD
- **verify**: supported — index table bounds; every sector index resolves
- **decompress**: supported — to WUD, byte-identical

### `xbox.disc` — Xbox full disc

XGD1 full-disc image (video + game partition). Extensions: `.iso`.

- **probe**: supported — XDVDFS descriptor at the XGD1 game-partition offset
- **inspect**: supported — as XISO plus layout
- **list**: supported — XDVDFS directory trees
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths
- **verify**: supported — volume descriptor, tree structure, extents within image; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — title updates are separate packages, not part of disc images
- **convert**: supported — to XISO (game partition only; video partition and security data not preserved)

### `xbox.xiso` — Xbox XISO

original Xbox filesystem-only XDVDFS image. Extensions: `.iso`, `.xiso`.

- **probe**: supported — MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA at sector 32 with default.xbe
- **inspect**: supported — volume and default.xbe certificate (title ID, name, region, version)
- **list**: supported — XDVDFS directory trees
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths
- **verify**: supported — volume descriptor, tree structure, extents within image; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — title updates are separate packages, not part of disc images
- **repack**: supported — deterministic filesystem-only image from a directory

### `xbox360.disc` — Xbox 360 full disc

XGD2/XGD3 full-disc image. Extensions: `.iso`.

- **probe**: supported — XDVDFS descriptor at the XGD2 (0xFD90000) or XGD3 (0x2080000) game partition
- **inspect**: supported — default.xex execution info plus layout
- **list**: supported — XDVDFS directory trees
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths
- **verify**: supported — volume descriptor, tree structure, extents within image; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — title updates are separate packages, not part of disc images
- **convert**: supported — to Xbox 360 XISO (game partition only)

### `xbox360.stfs` — Xbox 360 package

CON/LIVE/PIRS package; GoD/SVOD data parts. Extensions: `.`, `.god`.

- **probe**: supported — CON / LIVE / PIRS magic
- **inspect**: supported — content type, title ID, media ID, version, display and title names
- **list**: conditional — Games on Demand / SVOD packages with their .data folder; plain STFS (DLC, saves) is inspect-only
- **extract**: conditional — as list
- **verify**: conditional — header and XDVDFS structure; SVOD hash tables and signatures not checked
- **convert**: conditional — GoD → Xbox 360 XISO (untested against real GoD packages)

### `xbox360.xiso` — Xbox 360 XISO

Xbox 360 filesystem-only XDVDFS image. Extensions: `.iso`, `.xiso`.

- **probe**: supported — XDVDFS at sector 32 with default.xex
- **inspect**: supported — default.xex execution info (title ID, media ID, version, disc)
- **list**: supported — XDVDFS directory trees
- **extract**: supported — files with sanitized paths
- **verify**: supported — volume descriptor, tree structure, extents within image; signatures not checked
- **bundle**: unsupported
- **apply-update**: unsupported — title updates are separate packages, not part of disc images
